title: Ship a rootless OCI headless image and seed configuration

events.title: Ship a rootless OCI headless image and seed configuration
events.body:
## Outcome

Package the headless node as a reproducible rootless OCI image with one-command seed startup and explicit durable state.

## Implementation

- Build the image from the same headless binary and directory contract as #442.
- Run as a numeric unprivileged user with read-only application layers and explicit identity, mirror, configuration, and log volumes.
- Provide a declarative single-node configuration with health checks, resource limits, restart behavior, and graceful shutdown.
- Pin build inputs and emit an image digest, software bill of materials, and provenance attestation.
- Add upgrade and rollback checks that preserve durable data and reject incompatible schema downgrades.

## Acceptance criteria

- The image never requires root or a display server.
- Deleting and recreating the runtime preserves only documented volumes.
- A clean command starts a seed, passes health, serves a fixture clone, and stops cleanly.
- The same source commit produces reproducible application contents.
- Upgrade failure leaves the prior verified runtime and data usable.

## Dependencies

Consumes the service and storage contract from #442; platform variants continue in #473.

## Verification

Build from a clean dependency cache, start the declarative fixture, clone through it, restart, upgrade, inject an incompatible schema, roll back, and verify volume ownership and cleanup.
